entities.name: Query protein 308 aa
observations: Sequence is 308 aa; top Swiss-Prot match human FMO5 (P49326), 71.9% identity across 99.4% of query but 57.4% of reference, suggesting a homologous partial-length sequence rather than confirmed full-length FMO5.
Protein function and localization are not directly annotated for the query sequence in the sequence-analysis result.

entities.name: FMO5 (P49326)
observations: Reviewed human flavin-containing monooxygenase 5 catalyzes Baeyer–Villiger oxidation of diverse carbonyl substrates, inserting oxygen adjacent to a carbonyl and converting ketones to esters; FAD is a cofactor.
UniProt places FMO5 at the endoplasmic-reticulum and microsomal membranes; annotated processes include xenobiotic metabolism and regulation of cholesterol metabolism.

Reference reaction annotations include NADPH/O2-dependent ketone-to-ester conversion and NADPH oxidase activity; these are reference-protein annotations, not experimentally established for the 308-aa query.
